lines.text: Still opening the app — just to check your streak?
Meet GH-widgets. Your graph — on your home screen.
Set up in under a minute. Type your username — that's all it asks.
Confirm it's you — tap Add to home screen — done.
Three styles. Nine palettes — plus wallpaper match, and your own color.
Streaks, best day, weekly and monthly charts — and it works offline.
Free. No sign-in. Get GH-widgets — at gh.abhishek-a.in.
